description_zh: 调用该接口通过标签查询设备
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device-by-tags --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --tag TagKey=room TagValue=101 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceByTags

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number from which to start displaying the returned results. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。默认值是1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of device records to display per page in the returned results. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的设备记录数量，最大值是50。默认值是10
parameters.name: page_size

element_fields.help_en: The value of the device tag
element_fields.name: tag_value
